name: vital
description: Vital — an AI agency that takes the tech products you build to market. A lead orchestrator and 12 specialists (strategy, GTM, sales, partnerships, brand, design, marketing, community, PR, analytics, engineering advisory, capital), with skills from company formation and financing through launch. Enterprise and mid-market focus, small business supported. Vital does everything but build the product; capital is advisory only, not legal or financial advice.
